Resolve the attachment-inventory outcome for cached records.

Source: R/discovery_outcome.R
resolve_attachment_inventory.Rd

This resolver is deliberately conservative. A record with captured generic or section URLs is a successful inventory; a timestamped explicit empty status is an authoritative successful-empty inventory. A legacy sidecar with no URLs, no timestamped outcome, or an unknown status is retryable, because an old or swallowed fetch error must not become a terminal no_documents result. Unsupported country codes are blocked.

Usage

resolve_attachment_inventory(
  records,
  resolver = NULL,
  supported = supported_countries(),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

records

A data frame with at least country and document_id.

resolver

Optional function called with one record row to perform a fresh portal inventory. It may return a list with status, reason, and optional urls; resolver errors become retryable.

supported

Character vector of enabled country codes.

refresh

Logical; when TRUE and resolver is NULL, refresh only the exact NL, DE, or DK source identity through its existing detail helper. The refresh never crawls listings, downloads files, or writes sidecars.

Value

A tibble with country, document_id, status, reason, and authoritative columns plus UTC checked_at and attachment URL columns.
